name: @distilly/panel
description: Loopback-only Distilly review panel over an injected EngineClient.

scripts.snapshots: node scripts/check-public-api.mjs && node scripts/check-browser-bundle.mjs && node scripts/build-web.mjs --check
scripts.test:browser: tsc -b tsconfig.server.json tsconfig.web.json --force && node scripts/build-web.mjs && node e2e/panel.playwright.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
